blocks.text: SINGAPORE — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. urged Filipinos to prepare buckets and other containers to collect rainwater as the government drew up measures to address possible water shortages during the expected Super El Niño. Marcos said the government would launch an information campaign teaching households how to collect, filter, and treat rainwater to make it safe for use.
